mapper.select: select c.schedule_Date as scheduleDate, c.cx_machine_name as codeId, c.spec_desc as innerMsg, c.SAP_CODE as cpdh, c.embryo_code as specdh, (case WHEN instr(c.BOM_DATA_VERSION,'SZ',1,1)>0 THEN '试制阶段' else '投产阶段' end) as jd, t.estimate_start_time as startDate, t.estimate_end_time as endDate, NVL(class1_plan_qty, 0)+NVL(class2_plan_qty, 0)+NVL(class3_plan_qty, 0)+NVL(class4_plan_qty, 0)+NVL(class5_plan_qty, 0) as ydl, NVL(fq.CLASS1_FINISH_QTY, 0)+NVL(fq.CLASS2_FINISH_QTY, 0)+NVL(fq.CLASS3_FINISH_QTY, 0)+NVL(fq.CLASS4_FINISH_QTY, 0)+NVL(fq.CLASS5_FINISH_QTY, 0) as ywcl from T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT c left join T_CX_SCHEDULE_TASK_TIME t on c.order_no = t.cx_order_no and c.del_flag=0 and t.del_flag=0 left join T_CX_CLASS_SHIFT_FINISH_QTY fq on fq.ORDER_NO=c.ORDER_NO and fq.del_flag='0' where 1=1 and t.estimate_start_time is not null and c.spec_desc is not null and NVL(class1_plan_qty, 0)+NVL(class2_plan_qty, 0)+NVL(class3_plan_qty, 0)+NVL(class4_plan_qty, 0)+NVL(class5_plan_qty, 0)>0 and c.schedule_date = #{scheduleDate,jdbcType=DATE} order by c.cx_machine_name, t.estimate_start_time
